title: Longer decimal is larger
statement: A decimal with more digits after the point is a larger number, because the digits after the point make a bigger whole number.

evidence_patterns.item_shape: compare two decimals where the shorter is larger
evidence_patterns.signature: chooses the decimal with more digits after the point
orders by the digits after the point read as whole numbers

discriminators.vs_slip: A slip is one wrong comparison. The belief is diagnosed by a consistent pattern on length-incongruent items and a justification such as 'twenty-five is more than five'.

vs.math.dec.shorter-is-larger: Mirror belief. Include items where the longer decimal is larger (0.75 vs 0.8): longer-is-larger gets those right and shorter-is-larger gets them wrong.

conflicts_with.label: CCSS 4.NF.C.7: compare two decimals to hundredths by reasoning about their size

resolved_by.label: CCSS 4.NF.C.7: compare two decimals to hundredths by reasoning about their size
CCSS 5.NBT.A.3: read, write and compare decimals to thousandths
